description: This file contains utility functions and React components for generating and rendering tooltips in a deck.gl-based visualization within the Superset frontend. It includes functions for extracting data, formatting tooltip content, and integrating with Handlebars templates.

methods.name: extractValue
methods.description: Extracts a specific field value from a JsonObject, checking object properties and points array.

methods.name: formatValue
methods.description: Formats a value into a string, converting ISO date strings to locale strings.

methods.name: buildFieldBasedTooltipItems
methods.description: Builds an array of TooltipRow components based on tooltip contents and data object.

methods.name: createScreenGridData
methods.description: Creates data structure for screen grid tooltips, aggregating point data.

methods.name: processTooltipContentItem
methods.description: Processes individual tooltip content items to extract and format data.

methods.name: createHandlebarsTooltipData
methods.description: Generates tooltip data object for Handlebars templates based on data object and form data.

methods.name: generateEnhancedDefaultTemplate
methods.description: Creates a default tooltip template with limits applied.

methods.name: useTooltipContent
methods.description: React hook that returns a memoized tooltip content generator component.

methods.name: createTooltipContent
methods.description: Returns a function that generates tooltip React elements based on data and form data.
